q: Nova City is built on Mars. What protects it from the planet's harsh environment?
options: A thick layer of artificial clouds
explain: Nova City sits on Mars, the Red Planet, and is protected from the harsh environment by giant glass domes.

q: What gives Nova City its Earth-like, breathtaking view?
options: An artificial blue sky over red mountains and deserts
A real ocean stretching beyond the domes
Green forests covering the Martian mountains
A glowing ring of orbiting mirrors
explain: The city is surrounded by red mountains and vast deserts, while an artificial blue sky creates an Earth-like landscape.

q: Robot assistants, smart apartments and rooftop gardens in tall skyscrapers belong to which zone?
explain: The Residential Zone has tall skyscrapers, smart apartments, rooftop gardens and robot assistants.

q: Where would you find VR cinemas, high-tech amusement parks and automated restaurants?
explain: The Entertainment Zone offers giant shopping malls, VR cinemas, high-tech amusement parks and automated restaurants.

q: Which zone is home to intelligent buildings, AI research centers and advanced laboratories?
explain: Intelligent buildings, AI research centers and advanced laboratories make up the Technology Zone.

q: Which zone grows fresh food on farms and also has artificial forests, lakes and waterfalls?
explain: The Green Zone combines artificial forests, lakes, waterfalls and fresh food farms.

q: Which energy combination gives Nova City clean, reliable electricity?
options: Coal plants and large fuel imports
explain: Solar panels and advanced batteries provide clean and reliable electricity.

q: What does each dome have to keep its air breathable and comfortable?
options: An independent oxygen supply, air purification and temperature control
Oxygen delivered from Earth by cargo ships each week
A single shared oxygen tank serving the whole city
Open vents that filter outside Martian air with plants
explain: Every dome has its own independent oxygen supply, air purification and temperature control.

q: Which transport is listed for ultra-fast daily commutes between city zones?
explain: Hyperloops give ultra-fast daily commutes between zones. Inside the domes, smart transit also includes self-driving cars and flying taxis.

q: About how many citizens will live in Nova City?
explain: Nova City is a busy, lively city with about 10 to 15 million citizens, including scientists and families.

q: Why does Nova City build so many giant skyscrapers?
options: Living tall saves space and keeps the Mars environment outside safe
Tall towers block dust storms from entering the domes
Skyscrapers are the only buildings that can hold oxygen
Tall buildings give every home its own landing pad
explain: Living in tall buildings helps save space and keeps the natural Mars environment outside safe.

q: How does moving millions of people to Mars help Earth?
options: Less crowding and fewer resources used, so Earth can recover
Earth can send all of its waste to Mars
Earth gains fresh water from Martian rivers
Earth no longer needs any clean energy
explain: Moving people to Mars reduces crowds and resource use on Earth, giving our home planet time to recover.

q: Why is building a huge city on a dry planet so challenging?
options: It needs a lot of energy and a perfectly balanced environment
Too few people are willing to move there
Martian gravity is too strong to build tall towers
Natural forests must be cleared first
explain: The poster names the huge energy demand and the need for a perfectly balanced environment as the main challenge.

q: Which of these is NOT a vacation destination mentioned in the poster?
explain: The poster lists vacations to Earth, the Moon and orbiting Space Hotels. Venus is not mentioned.

q: How do robots help families in Nova City's smart houses?
options: They clean and do housework, saving families time
They cook meals only for visitors
They guard the front door at night
explain: Robots help clean and do housework, which saves time for families.

q: Which description fits a Nova City green building?
options: Rooftop gardens, natural light, solar panels and water-saving systems
Windowless towers with sealed air and artificial light
Open-air farms built outside the domes
explain: Green buildings bring nature to the city with rooftop gardens, flowers and natural light, plus solar panels and water and energy-saving systems.

q: What could you find inside one 'City in a Building' skyscraper?
options: Apartments, offices, malls, gyms and cinemas
Spacecraft landing pads and control towers
Only apartments, with all shops far away
explain: Hundreds of floors hold apartments, offices, malls, gyms and cinemas, so people can live, work and relax in one building. That reduces travel and saves land.

q: Which energy sources does the Central AI Brain safely monitor?
explain: The Central AI Brain monitors nuclear, solar, wind and tidal energy, optimizes the grid to prevent blackouts, and stores extra power to eliminate waste.

q: How does AI keep Nova City's roads free of traffic jams?
options: Smart signals that adjust in real time
Fixed 20 km/h speed limits on every road
Human traffic officers at every junction
Banning all vehicles during rush hour
explain: Smart signals adjust in real time to eliminate traffic jams, while driverless buses and taxis offer fast, safe public travel.

q: What can connected health devices do in Nova City?
options: Continuously monitor health and automatically dispatch medical help
Guarantee that nobody ever gets sick
Send health data to Earth once a year
explain: Connected devices continuously monitor personal health and automatically dispatch medical assistance when needed.
